payload.title: [Fig. 9] Schematic for the Plume Distance
payload.description: This notebook provides a schematic illustration to enhance the understanding of the plume distance metric by integrating multiple steps of the process. It involves loading and processing climate ensemble data, resampling data according to a power law, and calculating the plume distance. The notebook uses various visualization techniques to plot proximity probabilities and densities, ultimately combining these into a comprehensive schematic.
